?

The geometric series −1+2−4+8−16+32 can be expressed using sigma notation as

a
∑n=1612(−2)n
b
∑n=1612(2)n
c
∑n=16(−12)(−2)n
d
∑n=16(−2)n
e
∑n=16(−12)(2)n
